instruction: Please move the text layer to the top of the canvas. I want it positioned near the top edge.

metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the text layer to the top of the image. The evaluator checks if the topmost dark pixel (text) is within the top 5% of the image.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator uses contrast-based text detection by calculating background color from edge pixels and finding pixels that differ significantly (threshold=30). This approach can detect both dark and light text, addressing the color-independence requirement
The 5% threshold for 'top of canvas' is a reasonable interpretation of 'near the top edge' for the instruction
Postconfig properly exports the GIMP image to PNG for analysis, ensuring the state is accessible
The function includes error handling and logging, with proper return of 0.0 when text is not detected
Minor weakness: Edge-based background calculation assumes uniform background and may fail if text extends to edges or background has gradients
Minor weakness: Fixed contrast threshold of 30 may miss very low-contrast text or be sensitive to anti-aliasing artifacts
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using a more robust background detection method (e.g., median color of the entire image or adaptive thresholding)
Could add adaptive contrast threshold based on overall image statistics to handle varying contrast levels
Consider detecting connected components to ensure detected pixels are actually part of a text region, not noise
